metadata.description: Git workflow and project audit skills, plus coding, Kotlin and Compose conventions, derived from this repository's documentation

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Atomic Conventional Commits, pull request descriptions kept in line with their diff, triaging review findings into decisions, answering reviewer comments on a PR, and review rounds until a PR converges

plugins.name: kotlin-conventions
plugins.description: Points every session to this team's Kotlin conventions (style, idioms, testing, multiplatform), to read before writing or reviewing Kotlin. Pair it with coding-conventions for the general Clean Code rules, and with compose-conventions in an app with screens

plugins.name: compose-conventions
plugins.description: Points every session to this team's Compose Multiplatform UI conventions (MVVM, state and events, Compose, Maestro), to read before writing or reviewing the UI layer. Pair it with kotlin-conventions, which it builds on

plugins.name: coding-conventions
plugins.description: Loads this team's general coding and documentation conventions into every session, so they apply without being asked for

plugins.name: project-health
plugins.description: A manual /audit of a project's health: A–E state and effort grades per module and axis, blockers, bugs, debt and obsolescence, gaps to the conventions and a workload estimate, written to docs/audit-YYYY-MM-DD.md
